content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

When conventional platforms reject your transactions or impose fees of up to 10%, it becomes essential to create your own digital commerce infrastructure. Using COREMERCH's stack, you can bypass these limitations. You gain full ownership of every aspect of your sales process, from payment to delivery. With NOWPayments charging only 0.5% per transaction, you retain significantly more revenue. By processing 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you save $921 compared to platforms that charge higher fees. This architecture is built for resilience, especially in regions facing financial instability.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you'll need a few essential components. First, select a platform for hosting your storefront, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up a backend logic system using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. You’ll also need a database solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and a cloud storage solution such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Lastly, register for NOWPayments to handle Bitcoin transactions securely. This stack forms the foundation of your digital commerce system.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by integrating NOWPayments into your storefront. Create an account and obtain your API key. With this key, configure your backend logic to handle payment requests and confirmations. This is where Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script come into play, automatically processing payments in real-time. For product delivery, set up automated scripts that trigger once a payment is confirmed, ensuring your customers receive their ebooks instantly. This seamless pipeline guarantees that your sales process is efficient and reliable.
Gumroad's 10% fee can eat into your profits — NOWPayments is only 0.5%.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your infrastructure, it’s time to go live. Upload your ebooks to your chosen cloud storage solution and ensure they are accessible. Test your payment pipeline with a few low-value transactions to confirm everything works as intended. Once you confirm that payments are processed and deliveries are successful, you can officially launch your store. Monitor your transactions closely during the first few days to identify and resolve any potential issues quickly, ensuring a smooth experience for your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is operational, you can focus on scaling your sales. Use the data collected from initial transactions to optimize your offerings. Consider expanding your product range or increasing marketing efforts to attract more customers. If you reach the limits of your current setup, you can upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced features, allowing you to handle more products and streamline operations further. Your infrastructure can grow alongside your business, making it adaptable to your evolving needs.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage a personal digital commerce stack using COREMERCH. By setting up your store on platforms like GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you maintain full control over your sales. This method allows you to process payments directly, effectively eliminating reliance on traditional platforms.
You own your entire sales process, eliminating dependency on any platform.

Your Deployment Checklist
